_comment: Two layers: `$sandbox: none` turns off Codex's legacy sandbox modes so its native permission-profile system (default_permissions + [permissions.<name>]) actually takes effect (Codex ignores it whenever a legacy sandbox mode is set); the permissions.codex-run.* keys below are that profile, scoped to GitHub hosts plus filesystem denies for credentials and shell config. codex-run strips keys starting with `_` or `$` before sending config to Codex.
